description: [Launch directories] Use this when recording an outcome for a domain issued by next_directory, not submitting a tool to AgentoolRank. Requires the same Submit Kit key, that domain and status: submitted, listed, rejected, failed or skipped; listing_url and note are optional. Records the outcome and clears that site's unreported slot. Reporting 'listed' is only a lead: it counts toward listing rate only after our daily check finds it live.
name: report_result
